messages:
alex: Heads-up — consolidating postmortem follow-ups from the regional failover. I want a single tracking thread for owners, dates, and game-day prep so we don't lose anything between teams.

maria: Ack. I'll take ownership of the restore runbook updates and add a clear validation checklist (including success criteria).

sam: I'll own multi-region routing policy changes. Proposal: add health-check gating + shorten region preference TTL from 60s -> 15s to reduce flapping on quick failbacks. Will draft rollback steps. Target change window: 2026-04-15.

linda: Backup validation owner here. We hit a corrupted snapshot during the incident — I'll schedule daily integrity checks and run a full dry-run restore this month. First restore test: 2026-04-10. Example commands I'll run:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/latest snapshot.tar && tar -tf snapshot.tar
./scripts/restore.sh --env prod --dry-run --check-only
```

ton y: (tony): I'll add a replica-lag alert to page at >30s and surface the runbook link in the incident message. ETA 3 business days.

ops-bot: Reminder — canary failover game day scheduled: 2026-04-20 09:00 PT. Signup and runbook links: https://calendar / https://git/repo/123. Volunteers so far: @maria @sam @linda.

sre-oncall: Suggest adding a KV cache warmup step (5 min pre-warm) to the runbook — it mitigates 5-10% tail-latency spikes we saw post-failover. I'll prepare traffic shaping + warmup scripts. Prep due 2026-04-18.

maria: Ran an initial doc pass and opened PR -> https://git/repo/123. Please review, comments by 2026-04-08 would be great.

alex: Consolidated action list (owners + due dates):
- @maria: restore runbook update + validation checklist (PR opened) — due 2026-04-08
- @sam: routing policy changes + rollback plan — due 2026-04-15
- @linda: daily backup integrity + first restore test results — due 2026-04-10
- @tony: alerting/paging for replica lag + runbook links — due 2026-04-03
- @sre-oncall: game-day scripts + KV cache warmup steps — prep due 2026-04-18

alex: Next steps: please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept an action. We'll aim to have all owners confirmed by EOD today and sync weekly until items are closed.

sam: :white_check_mark: Accepted. I'll also include step-by-step curl examples for health-check gating.

linda: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Will post logs from first restore into #incidents after completion.

maria: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Will add explicit verification matrix to the PR.

ton y: :white_check_mark: Accepted.

sre-oncall: :white_check_mark: Accepted. I'll coordinate a dry-run with staging traffic to exercise the warmup.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll own tracking — weekly check-ins on Monday 10:00 PT until all items are closed. After the canary game day we'll run a short retro and close out postmortem follow-ups. If anything slips, raise it here so we can reassign.

ops-bot: Note: created recurring checklist task: "regional-resilience follow-ups" assigned to alex, cadence weekly.
